theorem: For a 2x2 oriented boundary map, det(Q)=ad-bc can vanish by cancellation while every entry remains nonzero.
invariant: The ratio ad/(bc) is invariant under independent row and column rescaling and is the multiplicative holonomy of the bipartite four-cycle.
reality_form: For Hermitian Q=[[A,P],[conj(P),D]], det(Q)=AD-|P|^2 is real and its chiral lift is self-adjoint.
hostile_discriminator: At a genuine interference zero, neither matching product ad nor bc may vanish.
open_target: Construct the four entries from a paired prime-archimedean correspondence square with Mackey normalization and noncommuting routes.
status: minimal coupled normal form; no source Xi construction and no RH proof
